classification.difficultyReason: Same sine rule for an angle then angle sum and SAS area as the reference, with only the explain part missing.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Using sine rule, find $\angle ACB$ to the nearest degree.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}
\frac{\sin C}{12}&=\frac{\sin52^\circ}{17}\\[8pt]
C&=\sin^{-1}\!\left(\frac{12\sin52^\circ}{17}\right)\\[8pt]
C&\approx34^\circ
\end{align*}$$
The supplementary angle is impossible because it and $52^\circ$ exceed $180^\circ$.

children.label: b
children.prompt: Hence calculate the area to the nearest square cm.

answer.worked:
Using the unrounded angle $C$:
$$\begin{align*}
B&=180^\circ-52^\circ-C\\[8pt]
A&=\frac12(12)(17)\sin B\\[8pt]
A&\approx102\text{ cm}^2
\end{align*}$$
